mapper.sql: r.id, r.user_id, r.contractor_id, r.estimate_request_id, r.rating, r.content, r.images, r.is_hidden, r.created_at, r.updated_at, u.nickname AS user_nickname, c.company_name AS contractor_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (user_id, contractor_id, estimate_request_id, rating, content, images) VALUES (#{userId}, #{contractorId}, #{estimateRequestId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{images})
mapper.update: UPDATE reviews SET is_hidden = #{isHidden} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reviews r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN contractors c ON c.id = r.contractor_id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM reviews r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN contractors c ON c.id = r.contractor_id WHERE r.contractor_id = #{contractorId} AND r.is_hidden = 0 ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT FROM reviews r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN contractors c ON c.id = r.contractor_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM reviews r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN contractors c ON c.id = r.contractor_id
